title: When the Cipher Burns
author: W. M. Nystrom
blurb: Orsen Winterbourne, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
